description: Start connecting an account: an Instagram professional (Business or Creator) account, TikTok, Threads, a YouTube channel, a Facebook Page, a LinkedIn profile, a Bluesky or Mastodon account, a Pinterest account, or a Google Business Profile (every listing the Google account manages). Returns a link for the signed-in owner to open in their own browser and approve on the network; the account then shows in accounts_list. The link works once, for 15 minutes, and only for the person it was made for. Reconnecting an account that needs it works the same way; pass `again` for an account that is still signed in on the network (fresh photo and sign-in, no forced re-login). Bluesky takes the person's `handle` (leave it out to sign in on bsky.social). Mastodon takes it too (@name@server), and works out the server from it. After connecting, the account's recent posts and numbers come in on their own, posting times follow what works, a brand with no link page gets a draft one (accounts_list followup says how it went), and a Pinterest account gets a default board. LinkedIn ends every app's sign-in after 60 days, so a LinkedIn profile is reconnected this way about every two months (accounts_list reconnect_by says when).

account_id.description: Reconnect this account (its id from accounts_list): signing in as another account is refused, so no second row is made. Left out, the sign-in finds an account of the same person by its ids, or by its handle when that account is disconnected

again.description: Reconnect the account already signed in on the network: skip the forced re-login

handle.description: Bluesky and Mastodon: the person's handle. Bluesky: name.bsky.social, their own domain, or a bsky.app profile link; left out, they sign in on bsky.social. Mastodon: @name@server (or a profile link); the server is found from it, so never ask for a server address

return_to.description: app: the signed-in iPhone app's own sign-in sheet. The network hands back to the app, which finishes with account_connect_finish.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: account_connect
title: Connect an account
